name: forward to the past
source:
I opened my eyes to a splitting headache and trembling hands. The room was empty, yet a voice echoed. My body felt foreign. In the mirror, two alien eyes stared from my own reflection...

[From [url=https://agencement.itch.io/forward-to-the-past]Itch.io[/url]]
